archetypes.name: White-Blue Flyers
archetypes.plan: Hold the ground while evasive creatures establish an airborne clock.

archetypes.name: White-Black Exalted
archetypes.plan: Build a board of exalted creatures and send one protected attacker through each combat.

archetypes.name: Blue-Black Control
archetypes.plan: Use removal and high-value defensive creatures to stabilize before winning in the air.

archetypes.name: Red-Green Aggro
archetypes.plan: Curve efficient attackers into burn and larger creatures before slower decks can stabilize.

archetypes.name: Red-White Tokens
archetypes.plan: Create multiple bodies per card and turn the wide board into sustained combat pressure.
